title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 Episode 10
key_events: Gojo sees Pseudo Geto aka Kenjaku struggling to maintain control over Geto's body as the real Geto's residual consciousness fights back. Despite the interference, the Prison Realm successfully seals Gojo. Yuji learns of Gojo's sealing through a Mechamaru earpiece and announces it to alert other sorcerers. Teams of sorcerers enter the veil, with Ijichi being ambushed by curse user Haruta Shigemo. Yuji reunites with Nanami, Megumi, and Takuma Ino to strategize their next move. Meanwhile, the Prison Realm strains under Gojo's power, forcing Pseudo-Geto to stay nearby and guard the seal. The curses argue over Yuji's fate, with Choso and Mahito wanting to kill him, while Jogo wishes to resurrect Sukuna.
content:
Gojo briefly makes contact with the real Geto's residual consciousness, causing Geto’s body to momentarily resist the possession by choking itself.
The reaction surprises "Pseudo-Geto", but he regains control and the Prison Realm successfully seals Gojo.
Yuji hears of the incident through a Mechamaru earpiece—part of a series of fail-safes Muta created in the event of his death and Gojo’s sealing.
Following Mechamaru’s instructions, Yuji loudly announces the seal to alert the other sorcerers.
Teams of sorcerers enter the veil; Ijichi is ambushed and stabbed by curse user Haruta Shigemo.
Yuji reunites with Nanami, Megumi, and Takuma Ino to strategize their next move.
Meanwhile, the Prison Realm strains under Gojo’s power from within, forcing Pseudo-Geto to remain nearby and guard the seal until it stabilizes.
The curses argue over Yuji’s fate—Choso and Mahito want to kill him, while Jogo wishes to resurrect Sukuna; Mahito proposes a challenge on who can find Yuji first.
